title: Analias - Stay Away
htmlContent:
Analias shared a new single "Stay Away". The music is incredible and filled with bright energy that, makes you fan out to the big time sound that stands out from everything you hear today. The writing tells the story to perfection, and the vocal tone has amazing appeal to make this a record you can see being played all over the world. When you think you’ve heard it all, he gives you innovation like no other to give you a sound that transcends culture, with a worldwide appeal that will touch dreamers and music fans everywhere.
